email.subject: Gearhead Pros: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I checked Gearhead Pros Auto Care's site. Two things likely cost you real business: there's no online booking, so anyone wanting an appointment off-hours has to call or give up, and your phone number isn't a tap-to-call link on mobile, so people have to copy it manually. Your footer also still shows an old year, which can make the site feel outdated to new visitors.

I run Northlight Web, fixing local business sites for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why. No obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
